text: WEST BENGAL STATE ELECTION COMMISSION 18, Sarojini Naidu Sarani (Rawdon Street) Kolkata — 700 017 Ph No. 2280-5277: FAX- 2280-7373 No. 3245(21)-SEC/3R-145/2022 Date: 30.12.2022 From : The Secretary West Bengal State Election Commission To : The District Panchayat Election Officer & District Magistrate Alipurduar/ Bankura/ Birbhum/ Cooch Behar/ Dakshin Dinajpur/ Darjeeling/ Hooghly/ Howrah/ Jalpaiguri/ Jhargram/ Malda/ Murshidabad/ Nadia/ North 24-Parganas/ Paschim Medinipur/ Purba Medinipur/ Purba Bardhaman/ Paschim Bardhaman/ Purulia/ South 24-Parganas/ Uttar Dinajpur Sub: Publication of Final Order for reservation of offices for Gram Panchayat, Panchayat Samiti & Zilla/ Mahakuma Parishad in connection with Panchayat General Elections, 2023 Ref: | Commission’s No. 3229-SEC/3R-145/2022 dated 23.12.2022 Madam/ Sir, Iam to send herewith the Final Order in Form — 1D showing the offices to be reserved for the Scheduled Tribes, the Scheduled Castes, the Backward Classes and Women from among the total number of offices of the Sabhadhipati & the Sahakari Sabhadhipati for all Zilla Parishads and Mahakuma Parishad of West Bengal, determined under Rule 2B of the West Bengal Panchayat (Constitution) Rules, 1975, vide No. 3243-SEC/3R-145/2022 dated 30.12.2022 for due publication of the same in such places where the draft of the said order was published. 2s You, being the Prescribed Authority, are requested to publish the Final Order showing the offices to be reserved for the Scheduled Tribes, the Scheduled Castes, the Backward Classes and Women from among the total number of offices of Pradhan & Upa-Pradhan for Gram Panchayats and Sabhapati & Sahakari Sabhapati for Panchayat Samitis within your district in Form 1B on this day, i.e., 30.12.2022 and publish the same in such places where the draft of the said order was published. I am to further remind you to send a compliance report on publication of the Final Order for reservation of offices at Gram Panchayats, Panchayat Samitis & Zilla/ Mahakuma Parishads to the Commission positively by 30.12.2022, clearly stating that the orders for all Gram Panchayats, Panchayat Samitis and Zilla Parishads under your jurisdiction have duly been posted in the manner prescribed. ‘A\Me-A\h\Share Folder\Panchayat Election 2023\SEC-3R-14S-2022-Office Bearer Reservation - Sabhadhipati\3245-SEC-3R-145-2022- Final Order for Reservation of Office Bearers - ZP - DM Forwarding docx
